message.content:
### Building a New PC – Step‑by‑Step Guide

Below is a practical, beginner‑friendly walkthrough.  
Feel free to skip sections you already know, but keep the order to avoid mistakes.

| # | What to Do | Why It Matters | Tips |
|---|------------|----------------|------|
| 1 | **Plan & Budget** | Know what you’ll use it for (gaming, video editing, office work). | List components, compare prices, set a budget. |
| 2 | **Gather Tools & Workspace** | A clean, static‑free area keeps components safe. | 1‑hand screwdriver, anti‑static wrist strap, plenty of light. |
| 3 | **Choose a Case** | Determines airflow, size, and aesthetics. | ATX mid‑tower is most common; make sure it fits your motherboard. |
| 4 | **Pick a Motherboard** | Must match CPU socket, RAM type, expansion slots. | ATX, micro‑ATX, mini‑ITX – choose based on case size. |
| 5 | **Select a CPU** | Core count, clock speed, integrated graphics. | AMD Ryzen 5/7 or Intel i5/i7 are solid mid‑range choices. |
| 6 | **Get a Power Supply (PSU)** | Supplies power; must be efficient and enough wattage. | 80+ Bronze or better, 500–650 W for most builds. |
| 7 | **Add Memory (RAM)** | Faster RAM improves multitasking. | 16 GB DDR4 is a good baseline; 32 GB for heavy workloads. |
| 8 | **Choose Storage** | SSD for speed, HDD for bulk. | NVMe M.2 SSD (500 GB–1 TB) + optional 2 TB HDD. |
| 9 | **Graphics Card (GPU)** | Needed for gaming, 3D rendering, video editing. | NVIDIA RTX 3060/3070 or AMD RX 6600/6700 XT. |
|10 | **Install the CPU** | First major component. | Align the pin‑hole, gently place, secure the lever. |
|11 | **Apply Thermal Paste & Install Cooler** | Keeps CPU from overheating. | Use a pea‑size amount; install the cooler per manual. |
|12 | **Mount the Motherboard** | Secure to case standoffs. | Align screw holes, tighten evenly. |
|13 | **Install RAM** | Insert into DIMM slots. | Click until it locks; flip if you’re unsure. |
|14 | **Attach the PSU** | Connect to motherboard, GPU, drives. | Route cables neatly, use cable ties. |
|15 | **Install Storage** | Mount SSD/HDD in drive bays or M.2 slot. | Secure with screws or tool‑free brackets. |
|16 | **Install GPU** | Slot into PCI‑e x16, secure, connect power. | Ensure the slot is fully seated. |
|17 | **Connect Front Panel & USB** | Power button, reset, USB ports, audio jacks. | Refer to motherboard manual for pin layout. |
|18 | **Cable Management** | Improves airflow, looks cleaner. | Tidy cables, leave gaps for fans. |
|19 | **First Boot** | Check BIOS, set boot order. | Press **Del** or **F2** during POST. |
|20 | **Install Operating System** | Windows, Linux, etc. | Create bootable USB, follow installer steps. |
|21 | **Install Drivers & Updates** | Ensure hardware works correctly. | Use motherboard’s utility, GPU driver installer. |
|22 | **Test & Benchmark** | Verify stability, performance. | Run stress tests (Prime95, 3DMark). |
|23 | **Enjoy & Maintain** | Keep drivers updated, clean dust. | Schedule periodic cleaning, monitor temperatures. |

---

#### Quick Checklist

- [ ] Case
- [ ] Motherboard
- [ ] CPU
- [ ] CPU Cooler
- [ ] RAM
- [ ] Storage (SSD/HDD)
- [ ] GPU
- [ ] PSU
- [ ] Cables (SATA, power, front panel)
- [ ] Tools (screwdriver, anti‑static strap)

#### Common Pitfalls

| Issue | Fix |
|-------|-----|
| **CPU not seated** | Re‑align, ensure lever is locked. |
| **PSU cables tangled** | Use cable ties, route through cable management holes. |
| **GPU not recognized** | Double‑check PCI‑e slot, power connectors. |
| **System won’t POST** | Verify all connections, check for short circuits. |

#### Resources

- **PCPartPicker** – Build planner, price comparison, compatibility checker.  
- **YouTube Channels** – *Linus Tech Tips*, *JayzTwoCents*, *Paul’s Hardware* for visual guides.  
- **Reddit** – r/buildapc for community support.  

Happy building! If you hit a snag, let me know which step and I’ll help troubleshoot.
